summary: Completed testing of 3 new features: Auto-Refresh Feed, Conversation Search, and Knowledge Gate Slider. All 13 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Conversation search uses MongoDB regex with case-insensitive flag ($options: 'i') - works correctly
GET /api/conversations/count is lightweight (returns only {total: N}) - good for polling
Knowledge gate slider uses 5 graduated levels (0-20: Strict, 21-40: Mostly Strict, 41-60: Balanced, 61-80: Mostly Open, 81-100: Fully Open)
Backend correctly syncs knowledge_gate_pct with legacy knowledge_gate field for backward compatibility
Frontend slider has gradient bar from red (strict) to green (fully open) with proper color transitions
Auto-refresh polls /api/conversations/count every 10 seconds and shows 'N new conversations' banner
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing conversations for search testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three new features tested: 1) Conversation Search - search bar on Conversations page filters by message content via regex, shows match count. 2) Conversations Count endpoint - GET /api/conversations/count returns lightweight {total: N} for polling. 3) Knowledge Gate Slider - replaces strict/flexible toggle with 0-100% slider with 5 levels. All features working correctly.
